# Components

Every component a flow can use, by palette section. Each page has its ports, settings and an example config. Every flow also has a Start and an End ([the flow format](../flow-format.md)).

## Databases

| Component                                  | Type                | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [MongoDB Delete](mongodb-delete.md)        | `mongodb-delete`    | For each envelope, deletes every document of the collection (database and collection fixed or expressions on the envelope) that matches the filter (an expression on the envelope, as in mongosh) and the envelope goes on with {deleted} in its output key (default `mongodb`).                               |
| [MongoDB Pipeline](mongodb-pipeline.md)    | `mongodb-pipeline`  | Runs an aggregation pipeline (written as in Compass or mongosh, an expression on the incoming envelope: `{$match: {cpf: $cpf}}`) on a collection (database and collection fixed or expressions on the envelope) once per incoming envelope and yields one envelope per document, the fields written into DATA. |
| [MongoDB Upsert](mongodb-upsert.md)        | `mongodb-upsert`    | Writes each envelope into a collection (database and collection fixed or expressions on the envelope; batches kept per collection): updates ($set) or replaces the document matching the filter, or inserts it.                                                                                                |
| [Redshift Delete](redshift-delete.md)      | `redshift-delete`   | Deletes the rows of an Amazon Redshift table whose Match on columns all equal the envelope's values (each a value or an expression on the envelope; null or undefined is an error for that envelope, never a wider delete).                                                                                    |
| [Redshift Execute](redshift-execute.md)    | `redshift-execute`  | Runs any SQL on Amazon Redshift (one or more statements; nothing checks what it does) once per envelope, in a transaction of its own: a COMMIT or ROLLBACK in the SQL is its own; what is still open at the end is committed (At the end: Commit, the default) or rolled back; an error rolls back.            |
| [Redshift Insert](redshift-insert.md)      | `redshift-insert`   | Inserts one row per envelope into an Amazon Redshift table, each column a value or an expression on the envelope.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| [Redshift Query](redshift.md)              | `redshift`          | Runs a read-only query (one SELECT or WITH) on Amazon Redshift once per incoming envelope and yields one envelope per row, the columns written into DATA (Override: only the columns).                                                                                                                         |
| [Redshift Upsert](redshift-upsert.md)      | `redshift-upsert`   | Writes one row per envelope into an Amazon Redshift table: the row whose Match on columns are equal is updated, otherwise it is inserted (Redshift does not enforce primary keys).                                                                                                                             |
| [SQL Server Delete](sqlserver-delete.md)   | `sqlserver-delete`  | Deletes SQL Server rows, one DELETE per envelope: the rows whose Match on columns all equal the envelope's values (each a value or an expression on the envelope; null or undefined is an error for that envelope, never a wider delete).                                                                      |
| [SQL Server Execute](sqlserver-execute.md) | `sqlserver-execute` | Runs any SQL on SQL Server (one or more statements; nothing checks what it does) once per envelope, in a transaction of its own: a COMMIT or ROLLBACK in the SQL is its own; what is still open at the end is committed (At the end: Commit, the default) or rolled back; an error rolls back.                 |
| [SQL Server Insert](sqlserver-insert.md)   | `sqlserver-insert`  | Inserts one row per envelope into a SQL Server table, each column a value or an expression on the envelope (an identity or defaulted column can be left out).                                                                                                                                                  |
| [SQL Server Query](sqlserver.md)           | `sqlserver`         | Runs a read-only query (one SELECT or WITH) once per incoming envelope and yields one envelope per row, the columns written into DATA (Override: only the columns).                                                                                                                                            |
| [SQL Server Update](sqlserver-update.md)   | `sqlserver-update`  | Updates SQL Server rows, one UPDATE per envelope: the rows whose Match on columns equal the envelope's values get the other columns (each a value or an expression on the envelope).                                                                                                                           |

## APIs

| Component                       | Type           | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [HTTP Request](http-request.md) | `http-request` | Sends one request per envelope (method, URL, query params, headers and body are values or expressions on it; $SECRETS works; the body as it is, or a multipart form of fields and text files) and the envelope goes on with {status, headers, body} in its output key (default `response`; a JSON body parsed). |

## Scripting

| Component                   | Type         | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Script Invoker](script.md) | `script`     | Calls, for each envelope, a function a script of its workspace exports (`@w/<workspace>/<project>/scripts/<path>#<name>`), its arguments in the order of its parameters, each a value or an expression on the envelope. |
| [TypeScript](typescript.md) | `typescript` | Runs `async function process($input)` for each envelope ($input is its DATA).                                                                                                                                           |

## Transformation

| Component                 | Type        | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Aggregate](aggregate.md) | `aggregate` | Groups the envelopes into batches of N, or All of them in one batch when the input ends, and yields one envelope per batch with the list of DATA in a field (default `items`): {items: [DATA, ...]}.                 |
| [Data Grid](datagrid.md)  | `datagrid`  | A table typed into the component: for each incoming envelope (usually the Start's only one) yields one envelope per row, the columns written into DATA (Override: only the columns).                                 |
| [Distinct](distinct.md)   | `distinct`  | Lets through (out-0) only the first envelope of each key and sends the repeated ones to the duplicates output (out-1, may stay unconnected).                                                                         |
| [Filter](filter.md)       | `filter`    | Evaluates a condition (an expression) on each envelope and sends it, unchanged, to the true output (out-0) or the false one (out-1, may stay unconnected: dropped).                                                  |
| [Limit](limit.md)         | `limit`     | Lets only N envelopes through, unchanged: the first N as they arrive (top) or the last N when the input ends (bottom).                                                                                               |
| [Lookup](lookup.md)       | `lookup`    | For each envelope of the input (in-0), finds the envelope of the lookup input (in-1) with the same key and writes its whole DATA into the output key (default `lookup`; null when not found, or a not found output). |
| [Mapper](mapper.md)       | `mapper`    | Writes fields into the envelope's DATA: each field is a value (fixed or an expression on the incoming envelope) and the key it goes to; a key that exists is replaced.                                               |
| [Router](router.md)       | `router`    | Sends each envelope, unchanged, to the output of the first case whose condition is true (one output per case, in order), or to the last output, else (may stay unconnected: dropped).                                |
| [Sort](sort.md)           | `sort`      | Reads every envelope, sorts them by a list of keys (an expression and ascending/descending; the next keys break ties, stable) and only then yields them.                                                             |
| [Split](split.md)         | `split`     | The opposite of Aggregate: evaluates an expression that gives a list (default `$items`) and yields one envelope per item, the item as the whole DATA.                                                                |

## Flow

| Component                    | Type       | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [Break](break.md)            | `break`    | Only inside a Loop (`loop: <its id>`): an envelope that reaches it ends the loop after the iteration (it does not go out of the Loop), and wins over a Continue with or a Next reached in the same iteration.                                                                              |
| [Continue with](continue.md) | `continue` | Only inside a Loop (`loop: <its id>`): the envelope that reaches it is the loop state of the next iteration.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| [Discard](discard.md)        | `discard`  | The end of a path that leads nowhere on purpose: drops every envelope that reaches it (no output) and logs how many.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [Flow Invoker](flow.md)      | `flow`     | Runs another flow of the project for each envelope, passing its Start's parameters and, with Send an input, the envelope's DATA or an expression as its input.                                                                                                                             |
| [Log](log.md)                | `log`      | Evaluates a message (an expression on the envelope) and records it in the run's log of the component; the envelope goes on unchanged.                                                                                                                                                      |
| [Loop](loop.md)              | `loop`     | Runs its loop region (nodes with `loop: <its id>`) again and again; each input envelope runs a loop of its own, in arrival order (parallel: 10 at once).                                                                                                                                   |
| [Next](next.md)              | `next`     | Only inside a Loop (`loop: <its id>`): an envelope that reaches it ends the iteration right away (what is still running in it stops; what reached Iteration end already went out) and the next one starts, with the loop state as it is (a Continue with reached before it still sets it). |
| [Wait](wait.md)              | `wait`     | Holds the envelopes of `hold` until `watch` ends (everything before it finished), then lets each go on with {status: success \| failure \| empty, envelopes, errors, firstError, last} in its output key (default `wait`).                                                                 |
